msg.sender must equal owner to execute list
tx.origin is written into the owner state variable, making ownership origin based

block.timestamp plus 600 is used as the Uniswap swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency

owner state variable is the authorization gate for distribute

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter only carries data into the transferFrom state updates and has no independent semantic identity
The _to parameter is only used as the recipient index inside transferFrom
The _value parameter flows directly into the unchecked balance and allowance subtractions of transferFrom
The _botProtection parameter is immediately stored into the botProtection state variable by the constructor
Parameter a is the direct delegatecall target of the unsafe delegate operation
Parameter b is the direct delegatecall payload of the unsafe delegate operation
The _tos parameter is the sole input consumed by the distribute balance overwrite loop
The _amounts parameter is consumed only by the list distribution loop
The _numList parameter is passed directly into the external addLiquidityETH call
The loop counter i is a temporary index for the distribute iteration with no standalone meaning
